description: Gives the space of deleted history back to the disk by rewriting the SQLite file (VACUUM). Run it after clearing history or lowering keepDataPeriodDays; it frees nothing otherwise. While it runs, Uptime Kuma cannot record checks, and it needs free disk space about the database's size. A large database takes minutes. SQLite only: refused on MariaDB, where Uptime Kuma has nothing to do. Returns the size before and after.
name: shrinkDatabase

freed.description: The difference, in KB / MB / GB

title: Shrink Database
